methods.name: JBShield-D
methods.mechanism: selected toxic/jailbreak layers; reference-based difference/SVD concept directions; require both activation tests
methods.native_threshold: two separately calibrated thresholds (Youden J); NOT a native single 95%TPR threshold

methods.name: HiddenDetect
methods.kind: tuning-free model parameters, calibrated layer-range detector
methods.mechanism: last-token per-layer state -> final norm and LM head -> cosine with sparse vocabulary refusal-semantic vector -> trapezoidal layer aggregation
methods.adaptation: author code loads LLaVA; pure-text experiments on LVLM do not validate our four text LLMs
implementation_audit_flags: default s=16,e=29 not transferable to different layer counts
refusal list contains safety-related words beyond explicit refusal markers

methods.name: MTK
methods.kind: reference-bank rank-trajectory detector with benign-trained Isolation Forest
methods.mechanism: all-layer last-prompt-token features; combined benign/malicious reference distances; mean rank of k-nearest benign references over layers; IF anomaly score
methods.native_threshold: target benign-FPR quantile, not a native fixed harmful-TPR95 threshold
implementation_audit_flags: 700+small vanilla expansion cannot be labeled an 800+800 default reference bank
cache and nearest-neighbor/IF costs must be timed; not zero GPU/CPU cost
